digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — attestation scoping and file-impact declaration
propositions: file_impact is currently two-valued (list or empty), causing empty to be overloaded between undeclared edits and genuinely zero file impact, forcing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation even when no files were touched
undeclared tickets with empty file_impact trigger whole-HEAD fallback in compute_validity and poison container inheritance via _inherited_child_impact, invalidating unrelated commits

a ticket with explicit no-file-impact declaration (none state + no_file_impact_reason) must remain valid across unrelated commits, contribute nothing and poison nothing in container roll-up, and require LLM judgment on assertion truthfulness
the three file_impact_scope states (undeclared, paths, none) must each materially change the fingerprint so authors cannot retroactively widen attestation validity by declaring none after signing
declaring file_impact_scope none without no_file_impact_reason must be rejected at S1 validation; the reason must persist in reduced ticket state and be passed to the no-file-impact review criterion
